use.read_order: Match the question to a topic; answer with its relevant step numbers and exact labels. Read only its cited spans when needed.
use.invalidate: Validate with python tools/check_handoff.py on a changed checkout. Any bound source hash mismatch makes this cache stale; review changed facts before rebinding.
use.current_state: No current statuses, prompts, counts, return identities, credentials or credit balances are cached. Use the existing selected process guide/runner when those facts are required.
use.not_authorization: Navigation data only; does not execute another engine, select scope, answer SME questions or clear gates.

steps.title: Open this job aid and understand its scope
Choose the person responsible for each action
Recognize the three fictional process packages
Download and extract the sample source package
Record your exact working paths
Understand the per-process folder rule
Create an authoring folder for your own real process
Create the real canonical manifest without inventing facts
Collect one nonsecret setup bundle before opening connectors
Open PowerShell and prepare the locked Python environment
Initialize the practice knowledge catalog
Prepare the one private workspace .env
Place the two approved CA files
Prepare clean Zowe configuration and its secure login
Prepare local Db2 stdio and launch Claude
Open the process UI, save source defaults and add a process
Select the manifest and preserve the fictional flag
Choose the complete source folder and process notes
Prepare and read the actual next step
Create a real process when exports are not yet available
Copy the current retrieval prompt
Launch Claude and send the exact retrieval prompt
Continue after Claude saves evidence
Open the source breakdown and inspect one rule
Select Yes or No deliberately, then Save
Select CICS fields and actions in a separate process
Copy the analysis prompt using approved safe evidence
Preserve legacy behavior and inspect v5 test obligations
Handle missing evidence without switching hosts
Accept only the fresh local analysis return
Download the issued SME review file
Have the SME answer and save the single-file return
Import the authentic return through the UI
Wait for verification and open the report

Inspect records and exact identifiers

Preview an estate estimate without pretending it is measured
Close and resume the same workspace
Use the checkpoint table when you cannot proceed
Review this draft and provide your criteria

topics.answer: Begin with one nonsecret setup bundle, then follow Your next step. Claude Code owns approved read-only Zowe/typed Db2 retrieval and safe local development/tests/review. Coordinator owns evidence/gates; actual humans own scope Save and SME answers. Originals, records and credentials remain protected.

External authoring holds manifest.md, process-specific.md and Endeavor. Stable process IDs own input, analysis, review, synthetic, target, reports and tests; shared target versions stay shared/target. No per-rule Markdown or process CONTEXT.md. Use exact WEBELX/Tran bindings; preserve historical WEDLX identities. Unsafe paths stop intake.

Supply ordered Process manifest and separate notes under Add optional analysis context. Originals are local intake. Claude drafts only public format/approved sanitized facts; the local owner verifies private bindings. Missing/conflicting identities stay prerequisites. Never infer names from hashes or treat notes as approval.

Ask setup facts first. Setup.ps1 runs foreground: py -3.12 → python → python3, CPython 3.12 patches, compatible .venv reuse, locked installs, PIP_USER override/restore with enterprise CA/index retained. No parallel pip/background retries. After text setup, Start.ps1 opens repository workspace; -NoBrowser only suppresses browser. Separate workspace uses workbench.launch --root. .env is not .venv; native CI is not desktop acceptance. Git keeps tracked public text LF under autocrlf; frozen examples retain bytes.

First ask one approved nonsecret bundle: repository/workspace, selected dev/prod and available HTTPS endpoint pairs, TSO account/code page/logon procedure, Db2 DDF/host/port, CA filenames/paths, registered driver and WEBELX/Tran locations. Selected pair complete; unused pair blank; Unknown explicit. No credential usernames/passwords, tokens/private .env/customer data in chat. Offline skips remote facts. Native text setup precedes process UI.

Copy public .env.example to WORKSPACE/.env once if absent; preserve existing file/local corrections. One file has Db2 8 + Zowe 11 keys. Database=DDF, SSL true; selected endpoint pair complete, TSO supplied. DB2_USERNAME/PASSWORD and ZOWE_USERNAME/PASSWORD are local editor/secure-client inputs only. Db2 stdio cannot prompt. Quote literal spaces/#/$, no expansion. Exact .env, not .env.txt/.venv; never print/upload/commit private contents.

Approved WORKSPACE/certificates/DB2-CA.cert is PEM/DER; ZOWE-CA.pem is PEM. .env paths are relative forward-slash certificates/DB2-CA.cert and certificates/ZOWE-CA.pem. Placeholder/syntax check is not enterprise trust/access. Never weaken TLS. Company-blocked Endevor/Zowe stays a gap; obtain complete approved manual Endeavor/ or folder-copy export. TPX is not an API host.

Env alone does not log in Explorer/direct CLI. Exit all VS Code windows; fresh PowerShell sets NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS to full workspace ZOWE-CA.pem before Node. cd workspace; zowe config secure (local human credentials), then code --new-window WORKSPACE. Old process/shortcut may miss CA; unavailable code needs approved executable from same shell. Keep TLS/secure store. Only bounded Workbench CLI child may load .env privately, never JSON/argument/model secrets.

Text helpers prepare connections first. Setup saves source/notes defaults and exact WEBELX/Tran folders; preserve connector choices. Save setup writes workstation.md and shows Intake settings saved → Add a process → Your next step. Optional connection UI and compatibility settings is collapsed and optional. Save does not authenticate or prove access.

Locked Python tools/setup_zowe.py --workspace WORKSPACE --from-env --env-file WORKSPACE/.env prepares clean config/schema without existing profiles. project_base is secure; DevPlex/ProdPlex use complete HTTPS pairs, selected pair required. Supplied TSO metadata creates no session. Approved PEM CA/TLS remain mandatory. Config/user overrides are preserved blockers. Workbench CLI child may load credentials locally; Explorer needs secure-store login. No jobs/writes; I*/Z* differ.

Run locked Python -m workbench.db2_setup --workspace WORKSPACE --env-file WORKSPACE/.env [--driver "Exact registered IBM driver name"], then Start-Claude.ps1 -Workspace WORKSPACE. Database=DDF; SSL true; CA certificates/DB2-CA.cert. Fill credentials locally before launch: stdio cannot prompt. Claude owns fixed managed child; no HTTP port/server terminal/MCP token. --offline is explicit no-server practice. Trust/driver/auth/read gates remain; typed metadata/protected exports only.

Copy current Claude retrieval prompt unchanged. Exact request/need IDs and inbox bind the return. UNAPPROVED_MODEL_METADATA needs approved sanitized identities/local deterministic export, never hash guessing/private request reads. Protected Db2 export resolves IDs server-side. Continue after complete save; unsafe/partial/missing evidence stays a gap. Never query fictional names live.

Default Yes is conversion scope, not approval. Use filters, choose Yes/No and explicitly Save requirements and continue. Save pins immutable Markdown/invalidates old tasks. Every No keeps its exclusion reason. Unsaved in-app choices are not evidence; hash/revision conflict requires Reload saved choices. Dependencies remain gates; packet issue locks scope.

After human scope Save, Copy Claude prompt for safe implementation/tests/review. SOURCE/PROGRAM/RULE_<hash> are exact task aliases resolved privately; never read originals to reverse them. Older tasks use Prepare a safe Claude analysis task. Missing approved semantics stays a gap. After tested adapters, restart idle loaded service if needed, --refresh and submit fresh task-bound --analysis-file. Acceptance is not verification.

Fixture-v5 requires 64 distinct randomized valid states per applicable logic/layout/step; 128 only for recorded compound-predicate/cross-layout/prior-effect risk. Actual target comparisons plus outcome, boundary, malformed, linked/sequential and mutation witnesses are separate obligations. Duplicates/finite/unreachable/unsupported states stay deficits. Source expectations freeze first; historical floors stay frozen. Counts/tests are not native parity.

Preserve evidenced source behavior, including apparent defects. Refactoring/consolidation needs observable equivalence and source/target/test mappings. Report source issues, never silently repair/retire them. An unverified native Db2/mainframe operation stays an exact gap; age, library availability or selected No earns no parity credit.

Use the online manifest/full protected program/BMS/COPY/CSD inputs and approved safe views. Human Save selects source-bound fields/actions. Literal BMS layout/rendering may be verified; SEND/RECEIVE, buffers, AID, session/security/recovery and effects need separate equivalents. Layout-only targets disable controllers; HTTP success is not CICS parity.

Share one issued sme-checklist.html. Actual SME answers Yes/No/Not sure, comments, enters name and Save review file downloads the return. Import once with matching real attribution and one designated HTML/XLSX inbox. Agents never answer or infer consent. Any correction/comment remains unresolved even beside Yes; preserve concerns.

Evidence & reports → Inspect evidence → Program comparison. Read Legacy source vs Modernized implementation, choose Program/Compare programs and Gaps only. Open View source, replacement and evidence for original/target spans, saved-scope linkage, satisfaction, tests and exact closure needs. Source obligations differ from requirements; shared target spans do not prove equivalence. Missing evidence stays Unknown; No stays omitted. Model detail needs sanitization.

Account every export/file/physical line with disposition and evidence/reason, including unknown text and selected No. Retained/selected/original/verified/omitted counts differ. Repeated calls do not inflate unique/job totals; cross-job memberships remain. Unknown estate totals are not zero. Originals/sensitive reports remain protected.

Authorized operator-only localhost Db2 / SQLite shows registered hash-checked read-only artifacts. Application database/Table filters preserve exact text/leading zeros, integers and NULL. Never send real rows/screenshots to a model. Prepare schema database needs saved Yes scope, closure and accepted Db2 provenance; empty schema is not business SQL/data migration.

db2_export_snapshot_to_inbox(process_id,request_id,need_id) writes private rows to the exact inbox; model sees only path/hash/count/scope. No real keys; full-table request uses empty keys. Snapshot-only response_ready permits Continue without reading private response.json; mixed requests retain NEEDS_LOCAL_PROTECTED_RECEIPT_BINDING. Local comparison binds keys/input/run/environment/completeness/consistency and separates baseline/final/run deltas. Uncommitted read lacks native parity; never run legacy jobs.

Use registered accepted report/management.pptx. Six editable slides share frozen evidence; Python AST statements are not COBOL rules. Immutable bundle requires eligible reporting; stop UI before direct runner bundle. Executive labels never clear gates. Sensitive bundles/source/row reports must not enter a model.

Import actual provider/account receipts through Effort & scale or --measurement-file. AI credits used stays attributed; historic Copilot is not Claude usage. Evidenced zero differs from Unknown. Never invent credits/allowances from tokens, requests, currency or configuration. Missing billing/receipts stays Unknown.

Record stage work; stop clocks before human waits and separate framework effort. Forecast same counting units from explicit assumptions or complete attributed qualified pilots. Business process is not JCL PROC. Fictional/blocked/partial/unmeasured/excluded pilots cannot establish full-estate rates. Work/service/elapsed projections differ; examples are not promises.
Python/SQLite is executable. Oracle, BigQuery, Java and .NET need new TargetBackend implementations and the same verification gates; configuration adds no adapter.

Reopen same workspace/process ID, retaining ledger, frozen inputs/hashes and one SME quota. Changed input needs new explicit ID. Stop clocks before closing; keep one Coordinator and eligible Resume after resolving the cause. Never rewrite evidence, delete locks/command markers or issue another packet.

Cache contains no live status/prompts/inbox IDs/counts/billing. Read selected UI guide, or runner status with UI stopped. runner agent inspection can advance historical/queued work, so is not universally read-only. Use safe projections; no raw database/ledger scans or new status proxy.

Read exact gate. Unapproved identities/semantics need sanctioned safe evidence, not hash guessing/private reads. Scope needs human Save; analysis needs fresh tested task-bound return; WAITING_SME needs actual human. Refresh after work. PENDING is not accepted; INDETERMINATE needs fresh inspection. WAITING_COPILOT is historical key, not dependency.

All 46 review-draft steps retain original historical captures/sample ZIP; newer labeled captures are scoped local UI/components. Current text overrides old labels/minima. Fictional status is not migration/SME evidence; never query sample names live or include them in forecasts. Screenshots prove no Windows 11, enterprise auth/access or parity.

Use prompts/CONTEXT.md for ownership and relevant authorities. It is not status or approval. This checked cache answers static guide questions; current facts come from safe UI/Coordinator projections, never database rescans.

Copy examples/process-specific.md into external authoring beside manifest.md/Endeavor; cite safe facts or Unknown. Upload manifest separately from optional notes. Intake freezes process-context.json; no process CONTEXT.md/input notes copy. Record grain/keys/nulls/reliability without customer values. Authoring stays outside evidence.

Originals/customer records stay protected in approved network, never model/tool output, prompts, APIs, uploads/screenshots or diagnostics. Comments/literals/control cards may contain PII. Use approved metadata/sanitized semantics and synthetic/approved masked examples; absent safe context is a gate. Operator-local rows differ from model access. Regex/config is not privacy certification.

Start-Claude preserves config and activates only managed Db2 under temporary --strict-mcp-config; separate workspace uses --add-dir. Stdio needs no token; retained HTTP auth is explicit. Human trust/policy remain. Settings deny protected source/inboxes/rows/SME/scope/derived evidence/secrets and row/search/write tools, not certify OS/DLP or approve views. Scoped reviewers lack shell/MCP/human authority. Never auto-approve all servers.

Record cited grain/keys/relationships/nulls/units/leading zeros/effective dates/reliability in one structured process context/catalog. Distinguish observed from inferred; missing stays Unknown. Approved metadata/safe examples only; no per-table/rule Markdown/customer rows. Catalog facts do not prove semantics or approval.

Fifteen pinned instruction-only adaptations plus four mainframe skills use .claude/skill-pack.json. Validate with check_skill_pack.py and reopen cached clients. Load relevant guidance after Start/contract. No MCP/hooks/proxy/runtime installed. Headroom is local; Karpathy independently authored. Skills cannot replace gates/humans; validation is not host activation.
